//: Every code the engine sends in a failure or an issue, with its English template. Swift's MessageCode and the panel's messages.ts both read this table.

codes.mustBeStringArray: {key} must be an array of strings
codes.mustBeIntegerAtLeast: {key} must be an integer of {min} or more
codes.outOfRange: {key} must be an integer from {min} to {max}
codes.invalidHost: {key} has a value that can't be read as a host: {value}
codes.pathHasQuery: match.path can't contain a query or a fragment; use match.query
codes.pathNotEncoded: match.path must be percent-encoded, as the app sends it: {value}
codes.responsesEmpty: responses must have at least one response
codes.activeNotInResponses: active must name one of the responses
codes.statusOrErrorRequired: {key} needs a status or an error
codes.versionTooNew: Configuration version {version} is newer than this plugin supports ({supported})
codes.authMockedOnlyFalse: authMocked can only be false, which clears the mocked session
codes.authMockedAlone: authMocked can't be sent with other keys
codes.orderMismatch: order must list every rule id exactly once
codes.conflict: Changed elsewhere first. Get the latest configuration and try again
codes.engineMissing: The Map Local engine isn't running
codes.fileUnreadable: Couldn't read the configuration file, so it opens read-only and won't be overwritten: {error}
codes.fileMovedAside: Couldn't read the configuration file, so it was moved aside to {file}
codes.fileTooNew: Configuration version {version} is newer than this plugin, so it is read-only
